structured.answer: I gave up and didn't pick a track. The page just lists 143 tracks that all look alike, all with fees around 0.6%. If I had to pick, I'd go for one of the big numbers like 26.39% or 25.86% (מיטב) "3 שנים", or an S&P track from a name I know like כלל or אלטשולר שחם. But it doesn't recommend anything, so I'd close it and ask someone.

stuck.why: The first rows have no company name above them. They have the cheapest fees and I couldn't tell whose they are.
I'm not sure if 24% / 13% '3 שנים' is per year or for the whole 3 years. Many rows say 'פחות מ־3 שנים' with no number, including most S&P tracks.
Bored by now. Every company has the same list of tracks and the fees all look about the same, so I couldn't choose. I jumped to the end.

stuck.where: Rows with 'עוד לא דווח' and the orange icon
stuck.why: Looked like a warning, so I avoided them without knowing what it means.

findings.what: The table's first block of tracks has no company name I could see, and it's the cheapest one
143 tracks that look almost the same and nothing says which one suits a beginner, so I'd rather do nothing
Fees only shown as small percents (0.5-0.7%), never in shekels, so they all feel the same
Lots of rows show 'פחות מ־3 שנים' instead of a return, including most S&P trackers I came for
Unclear if the return is per year or for 3 years; the 'שנתית ממוצעת' label is small and far away at the top
'עוד לא דווח' with an orange warning icon looks scary and isn't explained near it
Jargon everywhere: מט"ח, אג"ח, גמיש, ההפקדות
Very long page, no summary, I got bored by screen 10
